description: T-4888: second fresh sweep for IRR's zero-step stall rule, drawn after the two-part rule (|NPV| < 1e-4 and < 1e-12 of the largest flow, largest flows 1.3E-7..1.3E+14) was frozen (seed 'T-4888/stall-2'). 240 series of 2 to 150 flows, scales 1E-9 to 1E+17, guesses -0.9 to 10, each reaching a zero step at |NPV| >= 1e-7 within 50 steps.
